title: 第5章 使心机

content_zh:
他大概三十多岁，已经开始谢顶，有些胖，穿得也很随便，总是一件夹克衫和不同款式的法兰绒裤子，看起来就像是好莱坞随处可见的落魄经纪人，穷得连一身像样的西服都置办不起的那种，好莱坞之星的另一个当家女招待杰西卡对他印象不佳，因为戴夫曾笨拙地试着和她调过情，但被她毫不留情地拒绝了。
珍妮简和杰西卡谈起过他一次。
那是她们的休息时间，杰西卡钻到巷子里抽烟，珍妮简也跟了过去，杰西卡递给她一根烟，珍妮拿在手里把玩，但并不抽。
“应该是来为他的演员争取角色的小经纪人。”杰西卡吐出烟圈，冲着街道对面的六层小楼点了点下巴，她的语气中现出一丝艳羡，当然也不无妒忌，“最近对面又有大动作了，挺多婊子进进出出。”
在洛杉矶，演艺业是经济的一大支柱，好莱坞之星对面的办公大楼就被时代华纳下属的电视剧制作部门租了一层，这里平时人流量正常，但在一年的特定时候又相当热闹，好莱坞之星的生意在这时候也会迎来一个小高峰。
特定的时候一般是指一部新剧集的筹拍阶段，一般说来会在五月到六月之间进行秋季档美剧的筹拍工作，剧本大纲通过高层审核以后，制作部门开始组建剧组，除了多半早已经物色好的主演以外，还会有很多次要角色需要试镜，好莱坞之星所在的这个地段相当靠近好莱坞，但租金又相对便宜，在这里租办公楼做试镜用性价比相当高。
“也到试镜的时候了。”珍妮简单地说，把烟收到口袋里，“你不去碰碰运气？”
杰西卡之所以屈就于好莱坞之星，就是因为这里距离时代华纳的试镜点很近，她视此为自己飞黄腾达之路的起点。不过她在这上了一年的班，除了睡过几个对面的保安以外，还没能成功搭上任何一个选角部门的负责人。
没有负责人就不能进入任何一个选角导演的选择范围，直接跑过去递交简历试图霸王试镜只会被保安赶出来，杰西卡白废了一年功夫，也只能放弃打入电视剧圈子的努力，这几个月她开始积极投简历应征平面模特，也联系了一个模特经纪人。
珍妮提到了她不快的往事，这让她脸色一沉，“烟你不抽？”
“我的轮班马上要到了。”珍妮解释说——珍妮简有时会抽烟，但陈贞不抽。
杰西卡不听她的解释，“不抽就还给我。”
珍妮耸耸肩，把烟递还给杰西卡，“我得进去了，嘿，杰西？”
杰西卡对她挑挑眉毛，神色依然冷硬。
“我知道你下周有个试镜，祝你成功。”珍妮举起拳头，杰西卡的脸色柔和下来，伸手和她击了击拳。
“你也一样，姐妹。”
珍妮笑了一下，转身走进餐厅，大概过了五分钟，她看到戴夫推门而入，便取代杰西卡过去招待她：“嗨。”
戴夫明显在寻找杰西卡，他的回应有些心不在焉，“嗨。”
珍妮递上菜单，戴夫漫不经心地来回浏览了好几遍，但珍妮并不在意，她在戴夫身边站得越久，就越能看清文件夹上的文字。——虽然那是倒放的，也只从公文包里被抽出了一半，但珍妮或者说陈贞，有一手相当不错的倒读文字绝活。
这还得归功于她前夫，为了斩断，或者说拉长她前夫出轨的节奏，陈贞苦练过这一招，最后的功力达到只要眼角余光里有字，她就可以不动声色地她主要用这个本事来偷看她前夫的手机。

看来这一回杰西卡是走宝了。珍妮想，她把那几行英文字又读了一遍：‘5月13日试镜安排，一号办公室，《吸血鬼猎人巴……’
不必看完她也知道，这是WB电视网的王牌电视剧《吸血鬼猎人巴菲》在进行新季选角，按照摄录日程，巴菲应该是在七月开拍，五月会提前选出本季的一些常规角色，再做一些剧本上的调整，等到七月主演回归以后就可以直接开拍。
会有这么一份文件并且每天都过来，他不可能是一个演员的经纪人这么简单，应该是巴菲剧组的选角导演，或者更上一层楼，干脆就是巴菲剧组的编剧或制作人。如果能够攀上这一层关系，在电视剧中获得一个客串角色应该是轻而易举的事。

content_en:
He was probably in his thirties, already balding, a little fat, and dressed casually. He always wore a jacket and different styles of flannel pants. He looked like a down-and-out agent everywhere in Hollywood, the kind who was too poor to even afford a decent suit. Jessica, another hostess at Hollywood Star, had a bad impression of him because Dave had clumsily tried to flirt with her, but she rejected him mercilessly.
Jenny Jane and Jessica talked about him once.
It was their break time. Jessica went into the alley to smoke, and Jenny Jane followed. Jessica handed her a cigarette, and Jenny held it in her hand and played with it, but did not smoke.
"It should be the little agent who came to get roles for his actors." Jessica blew out a smoke ring and nodded her chin at the six-story building across the street. There was a hint of envy in her tone, and of course she was jealous. "There has been a big move across the street recently. A lot of bitches are coming in and out."
In Los Angeles, the entertainment industry is a major pillar of the economy. The office building opposite the Hollywood Star has been rented by Time Warner's TV drama production department. The flow of people here is normal, but it is quite lively at certain times of the year. The business of the Hollywood Star will also experience a small peak at this time.
The specific time generally refers to the preparation stage of a new series. Generally speaking, the preparations for the fall season of American dramas will be carried out between May and June. After the script outline is reviewed by the top management, the production department begins to form a crew. In addition to the leading actors who have probably already been found, there will also be many secondary roles that need to be auditioned. The area where Hollywood Star is located is quite close to Hollywood, but the rent is relatively cheap. Renting an office building here for auditions is very cost-effective.
"It's time for the audition." Jenny said simply, putting the cigarette in her pocket, "Aren't you going to try your luck?"
The reason why Jessica succumbed to Hollywood Stars was because it was very close to Time Warner's audition point. She regarded this as the starting point of her career. However, she has been working here for a year, and apart from sleeping with a few security guards across the street, she has not been able to successfully hook up with any head of the casting department.
Without a person in charge, you cannot enter the selection range of any casting director. If you directly submit your resume and try to dominate the audition, you will be kicked out by the security guard. Jessica has wasted a year of hard work and can only give up her efforts to break into the TV drama circle. In the past few months, she has begun to actively submit resumes to apply for print models, and also contacted a model agent.
Jenny mentioned her unhappy past, which made her face darken, "You don't smoke?"
“My shift is coming up soon,” Jenny explained—Jenny sometimes smokes, but Chen Zhen doesn’t.
Jessica didn't listen to her explanation, "If you don't smoke it, give it back to me."
Jenny shrugged and handed the cigarette back to Jessica, "I have to go in, hey, Jesse?"
Jessica raised her eyebrows at her, her expression still cold.
"I know you have an audition next week, I wish you success." Jenny raised her fist, Jessica's face softened, and she reached out to give her a fist bump.
"Same to you, sister."
Jenny smiled, turned around and walked into the restaurant. About five minutes later, she saw Dave pushing the door open, so she replaced Jessica and went to entertain her: "Hi."
Dave, clearly looking for Jessica, responded with a somewhat distracted, "Hi."
Jenny handed the menu, and Dave browsed it back and forth carelessly several times, but Jenny didn't care. The longer she stood next to Dave, the more clearly she could read the words on the folder. ——Although it was read backwards and was only half taken out of the briefcase, Jenny or Chen Zhen has a pretty good skill of reading words backwards.
This is also due to her ex-husband. In order to cut off, or prolong the rhythm of her ex-husband's cheating, Chen Zhen practiced this trick hard, and finally the skill was so good that it only takes the corner of her eye.If there are words in the light, she can remain calm. She mainly uses this skill to peek at her ex-husband's cell phone.
It seems that Jessica is lucky this time. Jenny thought, and she read those few lines of English words again: 'Audition arrangements for May 13th, Office No. 1, "Vampire Hunter Ba..."
She doesn't have to watch it to know that this is the WB TV network's flagship TV series "Buffy the Vampire Slayer" that is casting for the new season. According to the filming schedule, Buffy should start filming in July. In May, some regular characters for this season will be selected in advance, and some script adjustments will be made. Filming can start directly after the lead actor returns in July.
There is such a document and he comes here every day. He cannot be as simple as an actor's agent. He should be the casting director of the Buffy crew, or even better, simply the writer or producer of the Buffy crew. If you can build this level of relationship, getting a guest role in a TV series should be a piece of cake.
